subject_line: Renewal Strategy: Important updates for Acme Corp's Policy
email_body:
Hi John,

I hope you're having a great week.

I'm reviewing your Commercial Package Policy ahead of the renewal on Jan 15th, and I wanted to flag a few items early. We are seeing a general hardening in the property market which might affect premiums this cycle, specifically regarding the inventory coverage we discussed last year.

However, given your clean claims history, I believe we have strong leverage to negotiate. I've already prepared a comparison between your current carrier and two alternative options (Travelers and Chubb) that could offer better terms for your cyber liability exposure.

Do you have 10 minutes this Thursday at 2 PM to briefly review these options?

Best regards,

[Broker Name]
